content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"to view all my tasks in a report table with Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks metrics on the Task Reporting page","so_that":"I can see an aggregated overview of my tasks in one place","business_description":"The Task Reporting page gives the user an aggregated view of their tasks.
